context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:45 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): decisions draft-until-reviewed (a PR stays a draft until its review passes) and pr-review-record (each review round posts its record on the PR), cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — two lanes open their draft PRs now.

options.gain: You can open either PR now and read each review as it lands.
options.how: Lane pass-claim-cites-verdict (a report's pass claim must cite the check's verdict) and lane owner-override-one-route (your typed override goes through one route) open their draft PRs now, so each review record posts on the PR before the next push. Undo: close the draft.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: Fewer open drafts in your PR list.
options.how: Each of the two lanes opens its draft PR only after its first review passes.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: You cannot read a review on GitHub until its PR opens.
